caption: A four-panel comic using the stunned/smug pigeon meme format. Top-left panel shows a pigeon labeled '@OpenAI' with text about language models being powerful and being the only group building beneficial AI. Top-right panel shows another pigeon labeled '@OpenAI' with text about winning, set against a background with flames. Bottom-left shows a smaller dark bird labeled 'DALL-E' looking upward with text about AI. Bottom-right is a close-up of the pigeon labeled '@OpenAI' with a wide-eyed smug expression.
